title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-11-13
headline: Judge blocks construction of a planned triumphal arch in Washington

questions.prompt: Who stopped the arch work for fourteen days?
questions.hintKo: Judge Tanya Chutkan made the order.

hintI18n.en: Judge Tanya Chutkan made the order.

hintI18n.es: La jueza Tanya Chutkan dio la orden.
hintI18n.hi: न्यायाधीश टान्या चुटकन ने यह आदेश दिया।
